name: Heels Over Heart
source:
Your dream of competing on the grandest stage in gymnastics is shattered in an instant, leaving your life devoid of purpose.
Hoping to move on from your past, you transfer to a new university for a fresh start… only to stumble into a cunning trap!
With no escape, you’re forced to do the one thing you swore you’d never do again—return to the world of gymnastics and lead a struggling team back to greatness!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.gymast2&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
登上体操界最高殿堂竞技的梦想在刹那间支离破碎，让你的人生彻底失去了目标。
渴望告别过去的你转学到一所新大学，准备重新开始……谁知竟一脚踏进了精心设计的圈套！
无路可逃之下，你被迫去做那件曾发誓再也不碰的事——重返体操界，率领一支陷入困境的队伍重铸辉煌！

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.gymast2&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
